source: Fan-written mastery names and descriptions based on PotionMaker-REA localized potion names and each material’s lore.
note: These are fan-written mastery records for the remake, not recovered APK achievements. All 75 titles and descriptions are individually written from the paired potion label and note, material lore, supplier note, available customer review, and Pio/Tia mastery comments. The original APK contains only the listed customer reviews; entries without one draw on their original bottle note.
provenance: Every mastery title and description is original fan writing. Each entry combines its potion and material pairing with original localized text, the paired material lore and supplier note, available customer reviews, and the corresponding Pio/Tia commentary. No customer review is invented where none was extracted.

0-0.title: Apron-Splatter Apotheosis
0-0.lore: At the pinnacle of Sample Red Potion, sun-warmed Red Herb still offers only a modest beginner’s brew. Pio calls the cooperative’s “mild” label optimistic after the pigment crossed two wrappers; Tia keeps the one-day chill notice beside the stained apron.

0-1.title: The Basket Filed a Complaint
0-1.lore: Sturdy Mushroom’s orchard chill makes Baby HP Potion sticky and small, just as the original label promises. Pio checked the stopper twice; Tia filed the supplier’s protesting FRAGILE basket under evidence and kept the doctor’s note in view.

0-2.title: Terrace Fruit, Missing by the Ounce
0-2.lore: Raspberry Potion belongs beside desserts: clear-night Power Fruit brings the tartness, and the tasting card already says “more, please.” The supplier charges by weight, so Pio’s sampling habit is now itemized separately from the recipe.

0-3.title: Three Stars, One Sneeze
0-3.lore: Rainbow feathers make Small HP Potion easy to carry, but Alex’s three-star review says, “Drink it quickly, but cautiously!” Pio took the warning as permission to sip at a sprint and sneezed halfway through; Tia now keeps the supplier’s feather parcel sealed until the tasting table is clear.

0-4.title: A Collagen Color Check
0-4.lore: Mineral-flecked bird eggs smooth Collagen Potion into a nourishing tea-like tonic. The original label says to reject a changed color or misshapen bottle; Tia inspects each one while Pio keeps the discounted cracked shells out of the brew.

0-5.title: The Upright, One-Star Remedy
0-5.lore: Strange Powder settles into Homemade HP Potion, whose label promises help with fatigue and insists on upright storage. Jake’s one-star “tastes bad” review made Pio laugh until the dust reached his throat; Tia has since sealed the packet and the tasting panel’s mouths.

0-6.title: Road Flask, Not Knock-Off
0-6.lore: Drunkagora grows beside springs used by thirsty woodland beasts, making Normal HP Potion the travelers’ dependable choice. The village’s anti-counterfeit warning sits above the shelf; Pio stopped calling it a drinking contest after Tia read the notice aloud.

0-7.title: Cork Marks on the Ceiling
0-7.lore: Static-prone Manticore fur gives Carbonated Cherry Potion its forceful fizz. The supplier says the fur is naturally shed; Pio’s ceiling still bears the first cork, and Tia now opens the nutrition-labeled bottle over the sink.

0-8.title: Mom’s Heart Is Paper
0-8.lore: The Life ledger depicts Mom’s Heart as a sealed letter, not fruit; its ink gives Large HP Potion a keepsake warmth for long journeys. A bulk-sale banner hangs nearby, but Tia ships the heart flat and Pio no longer searches it for seeds.

0-9.title: The Sword’s Dewy Encore
0-9.lore: Dancing Flower nectar brightens Blessed HP Potion, and Brother Akai’s note says a pour can bless an old sword. Pio wanted to test it on every blade in the shop; Tia made him start with the rusty practice one.

0-10.title: Jam Before the Dungeon Bell
0-10.lore: S-class strawberry jam makes Strawberry Potion glossy and fruity, but opening it in a dungeon may summon monsters. The stubborn jar lid has defeated Pio twice; Tia keeps the discounted harvest in the pantry, far from the dungeon door.

0-11.title: Double Vial, Single Dose
0-11.lore: A sealed giant-bat eyeshine lens focuses Elixir of Strength’s temporary boost. The old warning says repeated doses may dull intelligence; Pio’s excitement is why Tia follows the supplier’s double-vial and no-eye-contact instructions exactly.

0-12.title: The Scarlet Circuit on Display
0-12.lore: Flower Fairy wings gathered at dawn tint Shining HP Potion red, but the bottle label reads like an appliance plate: 220 volts, 300 watts. Pio wants to wire a shop window around it; Tia has removed the plug, laid the bruised wings flat, and forbidden damp sleeves near the display.

0-13.title: Romorie’s Undead Campaign, in One Tooth
0-13.lore: Fire Dragon fang is the costly, sharp ingredient behind Advanced HP Potion. Romorie’s original note places it in an undead assault; Pio performs the battle as a one-man opera, while Tia uses wooden tongs and keeps the supplier’s collector license beside the case.

0-14.title: A Hot Pot Without the Panic
0-14.lore: Lava-cooled Red Crystal lends Fire Resistance Potion its heat-ready character, matching the original promise that hot pots are no problem. The supplier’s packing straw is not heat-proof, so Pio carries the crate away from the stove himself.

0-15.title: The Observatory Scroll Goes in the Pot
0-15.lore: Meteor ink leaves Enriched HP Potion heavy with the scorched-map flavor of a fallen observatory. The old kitchen directions demand ten parts water to one part mix, plus sugar. Pio tried using the star chart to find the pantry; Tia has drawn a clear line between astronomy and measuring cups.

0-16.title: The Vial That Asked for a Doctor
0-16.lore: A Succubus’s tear, shed after a broken vow, supplies Elixir of Rage with its sudden attack surge. The original bottle directs drinkers to consult a doctor. Pio wants to shake the volatile-looking ampoule; Tia has put the medical note on top and the vial behind glass.

0-17.title: Heaven, Four Stars
0-17.lore: Sunrise Seraph runes harmonize Celestial HP Potion, and Edward’s four-star review says it feels like heaven. Pio tried singing over the ink; Tia points out the supplier sent reagent, not karaoke paper, and keeps the sunrise copy safely dry.

0-18.title: Ancient Recipe, Modern Gloves
0-18.lore: Fire Dragon scales stabilize Ancient HP Potion, but its old promise of universal healing cannot soften the flavor. The warning says electricity may cause an explosion; Tia keeps gloves on, while Pio lets the tasting panel critique it from a safe distance.

0-19.title: Immortality, Dog-Approved
0-19.lore: Sage Stone gathers around a philosopher’s abandoned hourglass and lends Elixir of Legends its impossible promise. Red’s five-star review says the dog loves it; Pio saved the receipt, though Tia reminds him the supplier sells stone, not immortality insurance.

0-20.title: Dawn Is Not a Map
0-20.lore: The Pendant of Dawn forms where morning reaches the Underworld, giving Elixir of Dawn a red-light-of-doom finish that ends at daybreak. Pio followed its glow once; Tia now packs a real map beside the supplier’s non-navigation reminder.

0-21.title: The Ring Screamed First
0-21.lore: Cursed Ruby glass holds unfinished lab notes for Bloody Cursed Reagents, not a wearable jewel. The package is beautiful, the bottle seems to scream, and Tia lets Pio record the noise while keeping the experimental tag firmly attached.

0-22.title: Underworld Price, Human Warning
0-22.lore: Warm Demon’s Red Horn gives the minor HP brew a compact restorative kick. It costs less below ground, but the original note warns humans about the difference; Pio measures carefully and Tia leaves both horn caps on until the cauldron is ready.

0-23.title: Crimson Lace, Purpose Still Missing
0-23.lore: Red Plague spores are neutralized before they reach the serum, but nobody can say what the finished reagent is for—and demons are unaffected. Pio likes the lace-like scarlet pattern; Tia treats the supplier’s quarantine seal as the only useful answer and logs the jar unopened.

0-24.title: Red Tears, No Long Gazes
0-24.lore: The red tears are said to belong to Lucifer, and their color gives Red Essence of Pride its ceremonial luster. Its original warning is blunt: prolonged staring is dangerous. Pio proposes a portrait session; Tia replaces the mirror with a closed cabinet and a note to admire the legend from memory.

1-0.title: Blue Herb, One-Day Deadline
1-0.lore: Mist-ravine Blue Herb makes Sample Blue Potion a quiet beginner’s infusion; the original note says to drink it soon after opening. Pio put the bundle in the icebox, but Tia moved it back beside the recipe and saved the lunch.

1-1.title: Clever Caps, Resting Orders
1-1.lore: Clever Mushroom’s beechwood bitterness gives Infant MP Potion its small, focused dose. The label tells children to stop fighting and rest; Pio still checks under the straw for missing caps, and Tia has added “no wrestling near inventory.”

1-2.title: A Free Blueberry, No Homework
1-2.lore: University Wisdom Fruit gives Blueberry Potion a tart snack-time character, and the sign promises buy-one-get-one. The supplier says the fruit cannot finish homework; Pio ate the study guide anyway, so Tia now counts books as well as berries.

1-3.title: Refund Requested at Altitude
1-3.lore: Bluebird feathers make Small MP Potion easy to carry, though Maria’s two-star review asks for a refund. Pio says the feathers escaped during counting; Tia notes the refund request and tells the supplier that floating inventory still belongs on the invoice.

1-4.title: The Lid Learned to Fly
1-4.lore: A limestone mineral bloom enriches Bluebird eggs for Mineral Potion. The original warning says shaking may blow off the lid; Pio discovered the range, and Tia now stores each padded egg and finished bottle well apart.

1-5.title: Ina’s Difficult Sip
1-5.lore: Suspicious Powder cools Home MP Potion, whose name is less damning than its abandoned-observatory origin. Ina’s three-star review admits it is hard to drink and secretly liked it; Pio believes her, while Tia keeps the “probably legal” health-law note nearby.

1-6.title: A Root That Whistles Back
1-6.lore: Whyragora threads through shaded creek banks and lends Normal MP Potion a steady traveler’s rhythm. The health-law label ends in “probably”; Pio sliced the root and started a chorus, while Tia recorded the batch under approved, pending legal review.

1-7.title: Silver Molt, Zero Cholesterol
1-7.lore: Werewolf underfur leaves Carbonated Soda Potion with a vigorous fizz; its nutrition card claims 250 mana and 20 intelligence. The molt is ethical, the bubbles are not quiet, and Pio now opens the bottle below the ceiling fan.

1-8.title: Dad’s Youth, Corner-Protected
1-8.lore: The blue-heart letter called Dad’s Youth gives Large MP Potion a sentimental recipe story and a smart-adventurer discount. Pio wanted to fold the envelope into the bottle; Tia made the supplier ship it between boards, corners intact.

1-9.title: Bedtime in the Bishop’s Cup
1-9.lore: Dreamy flowers mirror the night sky even at noon, lending Blessing MP Potion a sleepy glow. Bishop Ellen’s note says it can revive a dead monster; Pio read it twice, while Tia keeps the bedtime-scented crate away from the cemetery.

1-10.title: Grape Gloss, Jar Lock
1-10.lore: S-class grape jam colors Grape Potion violet, but the label warns that minors may overindulge. Pio admires the gloss; Tia has placed the sealed jar high on the shelf and stopped calling the one-free offer a child’s allowance.

1-11.title: Gargoyle Lens, Exam Season
1-11.lore: Storm-loosened stone eyes focus Elixir of Wisdom’s temporary intelligence boost; the original warning says users may forget sleep and exams. Pio polished the lens until it reflected his own all-nighter, and Tia moved the alarm clock beside the bottle.

1-12.title: A Blue Glow Under a Heavy Book
1-12.lore: Lake Fairy wings gleam through Shining MP Potion, but the 220-volt label belongs nowhere near damp reeds or heavy books. Pio’s journal nearly flattened a wing; Tia made a weight limit and reserved the shelf for the fragile moonlit harvest.

1-13.title: The Drake Hunt Receipt
1-13.lore: A river-worn Water Dragon fang gives Advanced MP Potion its veteran edge. Romorie’s label credits the great drake hunt; Pio tells the expedition story, and Tia keeps the sharp tip in a case that paper sacks cannot lose.

1-14.title: One Bite of Winter
1-14.lore: Glacier Blue Crystal binds Frost Resistance Potion, matching the old promise that ice cream can finally be eaten whole. The supplier says the crystal is not candy; Pio asked anyway, and Tia marked the tin with a very large snowflake and “not edible.”

1-15.title: A Blizzard’s Most Important Ingredient: Sugar
1-15.lore: Blizzard ink gives Enriched MP Potion its cold, dense character, and its recipe is oddly domestic: dilute at 10:1 and add sugar. Pio suggested warming the scroll over a brazier; Tia stopped him before the frost-silk curled and posted the thaw warning beside the cupboard.

1-16.title: The Siren’s Quiet Prescription
1-16.lore: A siren’s tear is caught where song becomes silence, a fitting source for Elixir of Calmness. The original note says to consult a doctor; Pio whispers around the sound-stoppered ampoule, and Tia prefers that to another loud taste test.

1-17.title: Three Stars, Long Delivery
1-17.lore: Cherub runes from a warm marble cradle give Celestial MP Potion its measured grace. Leah’s three-star review complains about delivery time; Pio wants to blame the heavens, while Tia has already copied the supplier’s vellum-only packing note.

1-18.title: Do Not Shake the Deep Scale
1-18.lore: Underground streams polish Water Dragon scales for Ancient MP Potion. The original warning says shaking may summon monsters; Pio once tested the rattle, and Tia now keeps the slippery scales dry and the bottle very still.

1-19.title: Gray’s Knowledgeable Bargain
1-19.lore: Deep-sea stone stores the ocean floor’s mineral memory for Elixir of Fantasy, which promises all knowledge. Gray gave it five stars for value; Pio asked it for the receipt, but Tia says the supplier’s box contains no answers.

1-20.title: Daybreak Without a Conversation
1-20.lore: A pendant forms where dawn slips into the Underworld, while the original note warns its blue light may leave the drinker unable to speak. Pio likes the mystery; Tia packed a writing slate beside the daybreak charm.

1-21.title: Sapphire Tag, No Jewelry Bonus
1-21.lore: Cursed Sapphire Ring carries unfinished blue experiments into Ashy Cursed Reagents. The parcel’s screaming is noted but unexplained; Pio listened at the box, and Tia glued the stone to its tag before it could reach the jewelry case.

1-22.title: A Cool Horn, Double-Bagged
1-22.lore: Blue Demon Horn dust gives the minor MP potion a measured Underworld lift. Pio nearly left a cobalt sneeze on the ledger; Tia now uses the supplier’s mask, seals the bags, and keeps the receipt out of the dust cloud.

1-23.title: Cobalt Lace Under Lock
1-23.lore: Moonlit Blue Plague spores are neutralized for a serum with no known purpose and no effect on demons. The guild’s “inactive” seal stays shut; Pio admires the cave-grown color through glass, and Tia records no unauthorized peeking.

1-24.title: The Mirror Keeps Fingerprints
1-24.lore: Blue tears from the cold spring finish Blue Essence of Pride with a sharp reflection. The original warning says prolonged looking is dangerous; Pio checks for fingerprints instead, and Tia hands him a cloth rather than a second mirror.

2-0.title: Crooked Stalk, Straightforward Brew
2-0.lore: Wind-facing Yellow Herb makes Sample Yellow Potion a simple first infusion. The bottleneck expiry label is almost unreadable and names Pio as manufacturer; Tia writes the date clearly while he straightens crooked stems for the sheer satisfaction.

2-1.title: Mushroom After the Rain
2-1.lore: Lively Mushroom softens Infant SP Potion for small stomachs, while the original note says any ache should be temporary. The basket seems to disagree with the supplier’s aroma explanation; Pio closes the lid before the mushrooms can make a run for it.

2-2.title: Six-Pack, Strong Perfume
2-2.lore: Festival Spirit Fruit gives Orange Potion a bright citrus finish, and the old offer waives shipping on a six-pack. Pio nearly invoiced the fragrance as a seventh customer; Tia keeps the scented fruit away from the paperwork.

2-3.title: Kane’s Discount Negotiation
2-3.lore: Wyvern feathers make Small SP Potion pocketable, but Kane’s two-star review asks for a review-writing discount. The supplier packed them spine-first; Pio fanned himself with the parcel, and Tia charged him by the missing feather.

2-4.title: Two Hands on the Vitamin Crate
2-4.lore: A golden bloom from Wyvern eggs turns Vitamin Potion into a nourishing tea-like brew. The bottle must not be shaken; Pio carried the crate with both hands after the courier demonstrated exactly why that warning exists.

2-5.title: Olive’s Four-Star Wake-Up
2-5.lore: Storm-burnt Dangerous Powder gives Home SP Potion a wakeful warmth; Olive’s four-star review says it works when tired. Pio keeps the packet upright and away from sparks, while Tia praises the review for once being shorter than the supplier note.

2-6.title: Refund the Tampered Trail
2-6.lore: Three-path Whatdragora gives Normal SP Potion its travel-ready lift. The original note demands a refund if the bottle looks tampered with; Pio followed the root’s scent to the shop, and Tia inspected every seal on the way.

2-7.title: Empty Den, Full Fizz
2-7.lore: Kobold winter fur from warm basalt dens gives Carbonated Lemon Potion its crisp mineral kick. The nutrition card boasts 250 energy; Pio still checks the empty den with tongs, and Tia has forbidden bare-handed cave inspections.

2-8.title: The Explorer’s Golden Envelope
2-8.lore: Uncle’s Mystery is a yellow heart-sealed letter steeped into Large SP Potion; the dungeon-special ad promises a monthly discount. Pio found no return address, and Tia stopped him checking the envelope for fruit a third time.

2-9.title: Saitama’s Hair-Raising Blessing
2-9.lore: Singing Flower nectar makes Blessing SP Potion hum beside the old stage. Saitama’s note claims a pour can regrow hair; Pio offered the bottle to the mirror, while Tia asks customers to keep it off the singing petals.

2-10.title: The Jam Opens Before the Question
2-10.lore: Riddle-grove jam makes Potion of Riddle glossy and overwhelmingly refreshing as soon as the bottle opens. Pio still asks what fruit went in; Tia points to the supplier contract, which is more mysterious than the flavor.

2-11.title: Amber Eyes, Bathroom Breaks
2-11.lore: Ogre-eye lenses focus Elixir of Energy for city shifts, but the original warning mentions sleepiness and repeated restroom trips at high doses. Pio admires the amber reflection; Tia measures carefully and schedules a very convenient break.

2-12.title: A Golden Wingbeat in the Conservatory
2-12.lore: Autumn Forest Fairy wings make Shining SP Potion glow like a pocket-sized sun. The old 220V/300W warning is enough to keep Pio from calling it a night-light; Tia instead records the harvest’s dry-season origin and hangs the wings above the rain barrel.

2-13.title: Thunder Fang, Griffin Field Record
2-13.lore: Advanced SP Potion’s Thunder Dragon tooth carries lightning scars from the griffin-capture expedition described in Romorie’s note. Pio adds sound effects every time the fang flashes; Tia labels the wooden scoop “for this tooth only” after he reached for it barehanded.

2-14.title: No Sweater Shock, No Lightning Rod
2-14.lore: Summer-struck Gold Crystal anchors Electric Resistance Potion, whose old note promises fewer shocks while removing a sweater. The supplier says it is not a lightning rod; Pio took the hint and stopped posing beside exposed wires.

2-15.title: A Recipe Best Read Dry
2-15.lore: Thunderbolt scroll ink packs Enriched SP Potion with storm density; the cooking card calls for water and sugar. Pio tried unfolding it near steam, so Tia moved the parchment to a dry shelf and made the warning part of the recipe.

2-16.title: Anemone Keepsake from the Harpy Route
2-16.lore: Harpy tears caught among anemones are the unusual source of Elixir of Vigor’s enduring pulse. The bottle also says to seek medical advice. Pio packs a hat for the highland collection trip; Tia refuses to let either the hat or the unopened sample leave the labeled case.

2-17.title: Throne Runes, No Armrests
2-17.lore: Cherub runes copied from a golden throne make Celestial SP Potion worthy of the gods’ table. Eden’s five-star review—“It is delicious. It is so incredibly delicious.”—has become Pio’s favorite proof; Tia still reminds him that the throne itself did not fit in the parcel.

2-18.title: The Scale Is Dry, the Warning Isn’t
2-18.lore: Storm-season Thunder Dragon scales steady Ancient SP Potion, though rising body temperature may alter the effect. Pio keeps the gloves on after the supplier’s electrical warning; Tia keeps the tasting notes away from the thunderstorm collection.

2-19.title: Dazy’s Express Heroism
2-19.lore: Glory Stone carries a hero’s battle legend into Elixir of Hero; Dazy’s five-star review praises the very fast delivery. Pio asked whether a bard could certify the stone, and Tia added the supplier’s receipt instead.

2-20.title: Where Sunset Blurs the World
2-20.lore: Dusk Pendant marks the Underworld’s last light, matching the old note about a golden boundary between reality and illusion. Pio likes the peaceful horizon; Tia stores the glowing charm in its pouch so the night porter can sleep.

2-21.title: A Ring, a Scream, and No Proposal
2-21.lore: Cursed Topaz Ring gives Sunset Cursed Reagents their yellow-glass experiment history. The beautiful parcel still seems to scream; Pio nearly opened the jewelry case, and Tia reassigned the ring to the locked lab drawer.

2-22.title: The Horn That Pays Less Below
2-22.lore: Yellow Demon Horn powder warms the minor SP potion for Underworld travelers. It is cheaper underground, but the old note warns humans may react differently; Pio seals the dust and Tia checks the licensed collector’s label.

2-23.title: Yellow Spores and the Unanswered Label
2-23.lore: The yellow plague culture is rendered inactive for its serum, yet the original entry admits its use remains unknown and demons shrug it off. Pio calls the pattern guild-worthy; Tia files the supplier certificate under containment and will not break the seal for a better look.

2-24.title: Gold Seal, Not a Gold Coin
2-24.lore: Gold Essence of Pride gets its warm gleam from Lucifer’s golden tears, collected in a fragile ampoule. The label warns that looking too long can harm you; the supplier clarifies that the gold-colored seal is not bullion. Pio asks about resale value, and Tia locks the vial upright.
